scenes.headline: How a skill draws a film in code
scenes.sub: One pure function paints every frame
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Speck! This skill draws pictures and films by writing code, one frame at a time.

scenes.text: A frame is a pure function of its number. The same code gives the same pixels, so a film is a program you can run again.
scenes.say: A frame is a pure function of its number. Same code, same pixels, so a film is a program you can run again.

scenes.title: From a request to a delivered film

steps.say: It starts with questions, one at a time, about what, which style, and how long.
Each style is its own module, written in the order a hand would make the marks.
The module draws through one function that sees only the frame and its environment.
A gate scans the code for random calls and clocks, and hashes frames to check they repeat.

parts.note: pixels between dots at full black
parts.say: At full black the dots sit one point five pixels apart.
Paler tones raise the gap, so dot density falls as tone to the power one point two eight.

scenes.label: distinct styles, counted from the files
scenes.say: I counted thirty-two distinct styles in the files. Eight film variants fold into parents.

scenes.text: The count and the random ban check out. Render speed and film quality I could not run.
scenes.say: The count and the random ban check out. Render speed and film quality, I could not run.

recap: A frame is a pure function.
Each style is its own module.
scenes.say: A pure function per frame, a module per style, and render speed still unmeasured.
